pageTitle: A Promise to Our Customers and the Future
introText: At C.M.R., sustainability is far more than a buzzword. It is the foundation of our market and social research and guides every aspect of our daily work. Our commitment to environmentally friendly practices is demonstrated in the following initiatives:
sustainabilityCodexTitle: Membership in the ADM Sustainability Code / Climate-Neutral Company:
sustainabilityCodexText1: We are proud to be among the signatories of the Sustainability Code of the Association of German Market and Social Research Institutes e.V. This code is based on the three pillars of ecology, social responsibility, and economics and serves as a guide for ethical and sustainable standards in daily work (
sustainabilityCodexText3: We are recognized as a certified climate-neutral company. This certification confirms our commitment to actively reducing our ecological footprint. As signatories, we commit to reporting annually on our concrete progress and communicating this transparently. We are pleased that our industry supports this important initiative and works together towards a sustainable future.
dailyPracticesText: Sustainability is deeply anchored in our daily actions. From using environmentally friendly resources to energy-efficient work processes – ecological habits are standard practice for us.
homeofficeTitle: Home Office for Environment and Balance:
homeofficeText: By promoting home office work, we not only improve the climate but also support a balanced work-life balance for our employees.
socialEngagementText: Our commitment to society is demonstrated through important social projects that we support and advance. This way, we actively contribute to improving our community.
emissionReductionText1: Thanks to the continuous improvement suggestions from our employees, we are able to steadily optimize our emission balance. Our principle is: reduction instead of compensation.
emissionReductionText2: We invite you to join us and work together with C.M.R. to make a positive contribution to our environment and society. Let's make the world a little better together!
emissionReductionText3: We look forward to hearing from you and jointly realizing innovative and sustainable projects.
